$comment: Helm validates the merged values against this file on install, upgrade, lint and template. Draft-07, which both of Helm 3's validators read: xeipuuv/gojsonschema to 3.18 and santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema v6 from 3.19 and in Helm 4 (measured on 3.19.0 and 4.3.1). Patterns stay in the subset that Go's RE2 and ECMA-262 share. It describes metadata and configFiles; the other values are not described yet. The loader, MetadataKeys in cmapi/src/cmapi/core/metadata.py, stays the final check at start. docs/18-configuration.md, "Setting the keys through the Helm values" (#335).

metadata.description: metadata-keys.yaml as structured values: the whole file, each stanza written out ({} or [] when empty). Empty ({}): the chart's config/metadata-keys.yaml, or configFiles."metadata-keys.yaml". docs/18-configuration.md, "metadata-keys.yaml".

system.description: Keys that only the renderer sets

operatorOnly.description: Keys that only an operator (namespaces:protect) can set

reservedPrefixes.description: Prefixes of Kubernetes, OpenShift and platform controllers; * matches as in fnmatch, a trailing / is allowed

requiredLabels.description: Labels that each namespace carries, each with its rule

requiredAnnotations.description: Annotations that each namespace carries, each with its rule

keys.description: Optional labels, each with its rule

allowOther.description: Any other label under one of the prefixes, within the limit

keys.description: Optional annotations, each with its rule

allowOther.description: Any other annotation under one of the prefixes, within the limits

adoptionLabels.description: Labels that mark a namespace another tool made, with the values recognised (story #26)

sensitiveKeys.description: A change of one of these keys adds an approver-platform approval

emailDomains.description: The mail domains of the format email-in-domains

configFiles.description: The full text of a policy file, in place of the chart's config/<name>

requiredExample.description: A required key that cmapi does not derive (value) needs an example, which the API document shows; the loader refuses one without (#328 question 3, #332)

key.description: A label or annotation key: an optional DNS-1123 subdomain prefix and /, then a name of at most 63 characters

labelValue.description: A label value: empty, or at most 63 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.-] that start and end with a letter or a digit

prefixList.description: Prefixes; "" allows a key with no prefix, * matches as in fnmatch

rule.description: The rule of one key: at most one of value, pattern, enum and format

value.description: cmapi sets the value from the target of the request

title.description: A short label for a form, such as the portal's New namespace form; the key when absent (#336)

rule.$comment: Each dependency names the field that conflicts: a false schema at .../enum means that enum cannot stand beside the field named here

value.description: A key with value.from takes no pattern, enum, format or namespacePrefix: true

pattern.description: Give one of pattern, enum and format

enum.description: Give one of pattern, enum and format

labelRules.description: Label keys, each with its rule. A key that is not a valid label key is refused as an additional property

allOf.description: A format is for annotations only: a label value cannot hold an address or a URL; an enum value is a label value

annotationRules.description: Annotation keys, each with its rule. A key that is not a valid annotation key is refused as an additional property
